Scans    for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.
repos.one_liner: An autonomous AI trading agent capable of executing strategies across 1000+ markets including Polymarket, Kalshi, and various DEXs.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for high-concurrency market interaction.
Integrates with 5 EVM chains, Solana, and centralized exchanges for cross-platform arbitrage.
Features automated risk management and edge-scanning capabilities.
Designed for high-frequency autonomous execution in prediction and crypto markets.

repos.name: jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch
repos.description: Agent-driven research knowledge base. Agents collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki.
repos.one_liner: An agent-driven knowledge base that autonomously collects, searches, and synthesizes web research.
bullets: Python-based architecture for data ingestion and synthesis.
Uses autonomous agents to perform iterative web research tasks.
Transforms unstructured web data into a persistent, searchable wiki format.
Ideal for automating deep-dive research and knowledge management workflows.

repos.name: nashsu/llm_wiki
repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repos.one_liner: A cross-platform desktop application that automatically converts local documents into an interlinked, AI-organized knowledge base.
bullets: TypeScript-based desktop application architecture.
Automates document indexing and interlinking using LLM-based semantic analysis.
Provides a structured alternative to traditional RAG by building a persistent knowledge graph.
Useful for professionals managing large volumes of unstructured research or technical documentation.

bullets: Python-based infrastructure for defining and validating API/system specifications.
Standardizes development lifecycles by ensuring code aligns with defined contracts.
Reduces integration friction in complex distributed systems.
Essential for infrastructure teams maintaining high-reliability service architectures.
